title: Can a 1-tonne-per-hour mesh-belt annealing furnace maintain that output with different parts?
summary: Belt speed determines passage through the equipment, while the proposed approximately 1000 kg/h capacity also depends on loading and process. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s support-roller mesh-belt furnace proposal dated 13 June 2022 lists a 9 m heating section, 1000 mm effective width and 20–100 mm/min drive speed. It explicitly makes output dependent on workpiece shape, weight, stacking and process requirements. Use representative parts to establish loading and heating needs before assessing the capacity figure.
